t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Rep. of Congo) Mwenzem, me lengyuy: Nze oweng me ongir eyu, ongir eboyi, Lalé owu kapah, me ngy eyu obets onze, ngol anze, ompur ome, obwel onze.
